name: opposite_effect
left: Method X improved accuracy in dataset A.
right: Method X did not improve accuracy in dataset A.
reason: The statements assert opposite outcomes for the same method and dataset.

name: paraphrase
left: Method X improved accuracy in dataset A.
right: Accuracy gains in dataset A were observed with Method X.
reason: The statements may express the same result, but their wording differs.

name: distinct_measurements
left: Method X improved accuracy in dataset A.
right: Method X reduced memory consumption in dataset A.
reason: Accuracy and memory consumption describe different measurements.

name: scientific_case
reason: Co and CO identify different chemical species.

name: insufficient_scope_in_statement
left: Method X improved the reported outcome.
right: Method X did not improve a different reported outcome.
reason: The statements do not establish that the outcomes are comparable.

name: unsupported_existing_claim
left: Method X improved accuracy in dataset A.
right: Method X did not improve accuracy in dataset A.
reason: The statements assert opposite outcomes but one has no evidence.
